children: The Philippine central bank said on Wednesday it intervenes in the foreign exchange market to address disorderly market conditions and smooth extreme volatility, especially when these can accelerate inflation.
"We are monitoring the FX market," the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas said in a statement, which did not provide specifics on the intervention.
